clauses.quote: Teachers who choose not to participate shall not experience reprisals.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who choose not to participate

clauses.quote: The District shall not be arbitrary or capricious in the implementation of the High School Extended Day.
Unit members may volunteer for only one period before or after the existing schedule.
Unit members who choose to participate shall specify their preference and availability for before school, after school, or both.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members who choose to participate

clauses.quote: Unit members who volunteer for before or after standard-day high school classes shall receive 1/6 of their contracted salary
clauses.subject_text: Unit members who volunteer for before or after standard-day high school classes

clauses.quote: Unit members who volunteer for before or after standard-day high school classes shall receive the same rate of pay for all authorized paid absences.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members who volunteer for before or after standard-day high school classes

clauses.quote: Unit members who substitute for the additional period shall be paid at Factor E, Class II, step 5.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members who substitute for the additional period

clauses.quote: Unit members and Santa Ana Unified School District Retirees who substitute for a day in an Extended Day high school shall receive an additional 1/6 of their regular substitute pay.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members and Santa Ana Unified School District Retirees who substitute for a day in an Extended Day high school

clauses.quote: Volunteers shall receive two (2) days' additional accumulative sick leave per year or a proration thereof.
SAEA representatives and SAUSD personnel shall meet and consult no less than every two months.
The committee shall study and recommend prioritized alternatives for assigning teachers to teach a longer instructional day for comprehensive high school students.
